topic.title: [Dataset + Notebook] 139K harmonized MassBank spectra + fingerprints —  ready-to-use reference library for retrieval baselines
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Packaged 139,744 MS/MS spectra (20,204 unique structures) from public MassBank records into one clean reference library for this competition — precursor m/z, adduct, ion mode, full peak lists, plus precomputed Morgan + MACCS fingerprints per structure. Includes 648 spectra from the actual CASMI 2012/2016 challenge subsets.

Useful if you're building spectral-matching or retrieval-based baselines and don't want to write a MassBank parser from scratch.

Dataset: Notebook (spectral-matching retrieval baseline + EDA):

The notebook's baseline correctly retrieves the true structure at rank #1 on a held-out example — happy to extend with CCS/RT data if that'd be useful, let me know.
